questions.q: Which GCS is the native one for PX4?
questions.explain: QGC covers everything: firmware, airframe, calibration, missions, logs.

questions.q: How does PX4 integrate with ROS 2?
questions.explain: uORB topics are exposed directly in ROS 2.

questions.q: What is the PX4 log format?
questions.explain: Analyze it in Flight Review or with pyulog.

questions.q: Which mode needs a reliable GPS?
Which command starts SITL with Gazebo and the x500 quadcopter?
questions.explain: In SITL the uXRCE-DDS client starts on its own.

questions.q: When should you pick ArduPilot over PX4?
questions.explain: PX4 is stronger for research and ROS 2.

questions.q: Compared with Betaflight, the PX4 filter defaults (IMU_GYRO_CUTOFF 40 Hz, IMU_DGYRO_CUTOFF 20 Hz; 30 before 1.17) are:
questions.explain: PX4 targets larger vehicles; on a 5" quad they are raised. Add the ESC RPM notch (IMU_GYRO_DNF_EN).

questions.q: What does changing the airframe in QGC reset?
questions.explain: After the change, set the vehicle up again.
